summary: Local sources are thin: the complaints that surface are wild elephants and crop raids, waterlogging and power cuts in monsoon, and Ganga erosion, all reported at Bijnor/Najibabad district level rather than for Nagina AC itself.

positives.english: * Sugarcane remains a main cash crop for farmers here.
positives.hindi: * गन्ना अब भी किसानों की मुख्य नकदी फसल बना हुआ है
positives.basis: Inference: the ICAR study says sugarcane fields near the forest edge in Najibabad forest division are raided by elephants more than rice, wheat or vegetables. It shows sugarcane is grown there, but does not say it is a main income source.

sources.outlet: Indian Journal of Animal Sciences (ICAR e-pubs)

positives.english: * Police and local administration reach road blockades quickly.
positives.hindi: * सड़क जाम हो तो प्रशासन और पुलिस जल्दी मौके पर पहुँचते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: a 2018 Patrika report from Bijnor city (Nagina Road) says the SDM, City Circle Officer and police reached a family's road blockade and cleared it after giving assurances. This is one old, district-level event.

positives.english: * Forest department says it will try to get crop compensation under the rules.
positives.hindi: * वन विभाग मुआवजा दिलाने की कोशिश करने की बात कहता है
positives.basis: Inference: in a 2022 Amar Ujala report from Afzalgarh (Bijnor district, village Bhikkawala), Ranger R.K. Bhatt said the department would try to get farmers compensation under the rules. Villagers in the same report said the department had not acted despite repeated complaints. District-level and not Nagina AC.

positives.english: * Local shops and markets keep daily life going.
positives.hindi: * छोटी दुकानें और बाज़ार रोज़मर्रा का काम चलाए रखते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source found for this. Included only as a generic positive for a town constituency; needs a field check.

positives.english: * Farmers use nearby canals and rivers to irrigate their fields.
positives.hindi: * किसान पास की नहर और नदी से खेतों की सिंचाई करते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source found for this. Included as a generic positive for a Ganga-belt farming area; needs a field check.

negatives.english: Wild elephants come up to village paths, and the forest team arrives late.
negatives.hindi: हाथी गाँव के रास्ते तक आ जाते हैं, वन विभाग देर से पहुँचता है
negatives.basis: Rampur Chadha village (Mandawali area, Bhagwala police post), Bijnor district: a woman was killed by an elephant on the path to fetch milk; villagers allege the forest team reached about two hours after they informed the authorities and demand stronger safety measures. District-level; Nagina AC membership of this village is not confirmed.

negatives.english: When it rains, roads and homes go under water.
negatives.hindi: बारिश हो तो सड़कें और घर पानी में डूब जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Najibabad, Bijnor district (4 Aug 2025 Amar Ujala video): heavy rain waterlogged roads and homes in Mughlushah and Maqbara areas and made school travel hard. District-level; Najibabad city is a separate AC, but Nagina AC includes parts of Najibabad tehsil.

negatives.english: Elephants raid sugarcane fields near the forest edge.
negatives.hindi: जंगल के किनारे गन्ने के खेत हाथी उजाड़ जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Study of Najibabad forest division, Bijnor district (Indian Journal of Animal Sciences): elephants are the most problematic crop raider, followed by nilgai, and sugarcane near the forest edge is raided more than rice, wheat or vegetables. District-level academic study, not a news report; villages are not named.

sources.outlet: Indian Journal of Animal Sciences (ICAR e-pubs)

negatives.english: Power goes off during rain, and inverters run out.
negatives.hindi: बारिश में बिजली गुल, इन्वर्टर भी खत्म हो जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Bijnor city (4 Aug 2025 Patrika): after the rain, power was cut in several areas when the Awas Vikas power house shut down, and inverters ran out. District-level, city-level report.

negatives.english: Ganga erosion is eating farmland and moving toward homes.
negatives.hindi: गंगा कटान से खेत और घर नदी की ओर खिसक रहे हैं
negatives.basis: Gauspur village, Nangalsoti/Najibabad, Bijnor district (Amar Ujala, 18 Jul 2021): the Ganga cut about 20 metres toward the village in a month, several bighas of farmland were lost, and villagers say the administration took no concrete action. District-level and old (2021); the current status is unverified.

notes: Identity confirmed from Wikipedia: AC 18, Nagina, Bijnor district, SC reserved. The constituency covers KCs Akbarabad, Kiratpur and Kiratpur MB of Najibabad tehsil, and KC Nagina and Nagina MB of Nagina tehsil. The Hindi name (नगीना) is the standard name but was not on the cited page. The search pass is incomplete: the web search returned a too_many_requests error and then a budget-exhausted notice after about 13 searches, so I could not run the planned Nagina-specific queries (sugarcane dues and mills, Nagina CHC, Kishanpur-Nagina road, Malin river, drinking water). Almost all negatives are district-level (Bijnor/Najibabad), not Nagina AC-specific, so the brief's 3-of-5 AC-specific rule is not met on strict reading; they are flagged as district-level in each basis. Positives 4 and 5 have no source. Unverified leads for field check: a Nagina MP (Chandrashekhar Azad) 2024 campaign list naming stray cattle, monsoon floods and groundwater quality (seen only in search snippets; The Hindu page returned 403, and the Outlook page I fetched does not contain it); Lok Sabha question on Kishanpur-Nagina and Bijnor-Kotwali road conditions (undated, probably old, not fetched). The Gauspur item (2021) and the Patrika item (2018) are older than the 2024-2026 preference. Bhikkawala (Afzalgarh) and Rampur Chadha are Bijnor district villages whose Nagina AC membership is not confirmed.
